<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ResizablePanelEmits, ResizablePanelProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/resizable'
import { Resizable } from '@vase-ui/vue/resizable'
import { useTemplateRef } from 'vue'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ ResizablePanelProps {}
interface Emits extends /* @vue-ignore */ ResizablePanelEmits {}

defineProps<Props>()
defineEmits<Emits>()

const panel = useTemplateRef<InstanceType<typeof Resizable.Panel>>('panel')

defineExpose({
  collapse: () => panel.value?.collapse(),
  expand: () => panel.value?.expand(),
  resize: (size: number | string) => panel.value?.resize(size),
  isCollapsed: () => panel.value?.isCollapsed(),
})
</script>

<template>
  <Resizable.Panel
    ref="panel"
    data-slot="resizable-panel"
  >
    <slot />
  </Resizable.Panel>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ResizableRootEmits, ResizableRootProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/resizable'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { Resizable } from '@vase-ui/vue/resizable'
import { cn } from 'cn'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ ResizableRootProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
  direction?: ResizableRootProps['orientation']
}
interface Emits extends /* @vue-ignore */ ResizableRootEmits {}

const props = defineProps<Props>()
defineEmits<Emits>()
</script>

<template>
  <Resizable.Root
    data-slot="resizable-panel-group"
    v-bind="direction !== undefined ? { orientation: direction } : undefined"
    :class="cn('flex h-full w-full data-[orientation=vertical]:flex-col', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </Resizable.Root>
</template>

export { default as ResizableHandle } from './ResizableHandle.vue'
export { default as ResizablePanel } from './ResizablePanel.vue'
export { default as ResizablePanelGroup } from './ResizablePanelGroup.vue'
